description: Downloads Blackboard Learn courses through a signed-in browser session and turns each into pages: content items with due dates and grades, pdf, slide and Word text, video transcripts, announcements, discussions and a course overview. Runs as a scheduled job or by hand.
name: channel-blackboard
usage: /channel-blackboard <login <base_url>|whoami|courses|harvest <courseId>|notes <harvest dir>>; a job's stages run by ticket

timezone.prompt: The time zone due dates read in, an IANA name (America/Chicago); blank keeps UTC

files.prompt: Fetch attachments, pdfs and videos (download), or only the course's own text (skip)

discussions.prompt: Pull discussion boards (include), whose pages carry classmates' names and posts into the committed wiki, or none (skip)

current.prompt: Is this a course you're taking now? true, or false for a past course; it is written once onto the course's root page (README.md), where a later edit stands

watch.note: One job per course. The target is the course's url as the browser shows it (https://<host>/ultra/courses/_123_1/outline); its host is the site. Bind the signed-in browser credential to the job: `credentials bind job <slug> dir=<credential>`. A course video with no captions waits on this machine's transcribe engine.
